title: This Mole Finds and Eats Food in 120 Milliseconds, a Mammal Record

scenes.text: This mole can find and eat its food in one hundred and twenty milliseconds.
That's the fastest eating of any mammal, and it's in the record books.
Its nose has twenty-two fleshy tentacles shaped like a star.
They hold about twenty-five thousand touch sensors, and they tap up to ten times a second.
It feels its way through dark tunnels and snaps up prey in the blink of an eye.
A nose that works faster than you can blink.

description:
The star-nosed mole can find and eat a small prey item in as little as 120 milliseconds, the fastest recorded for any mammal.
Its star-shaped nose has 22 tentacles and about 25,000 touch sensors.
Would you want this nose?
first_comment: Which would you rather have: a star nose or x-ray eyes?
